wiperstoggle.title: Wipers: Toggle Speed
wiperstoggle.desc: Toggles between the speed of the windshield wipers or switches them off.

wipersdown.title: Wipers: Decrease Speed
wipersdown.desc: Decreases the speed of the windshield wipers or turns them off.

wipersup.title: Wipers: Increase Speed
wipersup.desc: Increase the speed of the windshield wipers or switches them on.

togglegascap.title: Engine: Toggle Rally Gas Cap
togglegascap.desc: Open and closed the rally gas cap.

togglefuelcap.title: Engine: Toggle Fuel Cap
togglefuelcap.desc: Open and closed the fuel cap.

batteryinfo.title: Battery: Show Satus
batteryinfo.desc: Shows the current charge and remaining time of the battery.
